function.name: list_files
function.description: List a bounded recursive directory tree. The result reports truncated and omitted_directories when the workspace is large.

function.name: find_files
function.description: Find files by exact name or glob pattern. Matches against both relative paths and base names.

pattern.description: Exact file name or glob such as *.css, config*, or src/*.php.

path.description: Optional relative directory to search in; defaults to the workspace root.

max_results.description: Maximum number of paths to return; defaults to 100.

function.name: search_files
function.description: Search text files for a literal phrase or a raw PCRE regular expression. Returns matching file paths, line numbers, and line excerpts.

query.description: Literal search phrase, or raw PCRE pattern when regex is true. Do not include regex delimiters.

regex.description: Treat query as a PCRE regular expression. Defaults to false.

path.description: Optional relative directory to search in; defaults to the workspace root.

max_results.description: Maximum matching lines to return; defaults to 100.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a small UTF-8 text file. Large results are returned with truncated=true and a suggested read_file_fragment range.

function.name: multi_read_files
function.description: Read several UTF-8 text files in one tool call. Pass paths as an array of 1–24 relative paths, or pass the exact string all to build one workspace snapshot. Use this first when resuming a complex task. The result preserves complete files until the configured snapshot budget is reached, then reports omitted paths explicitly.

paths.description: An array of up to 24 relative file paths, or the string all.

function.name: read_file_fragment
function.description: Read a bounded fragment of a UTF-8 text file by an inclusive line range or byte range. The result reports the next range when truncated.

start_line.description: First line to read, inclusive. Requires end_line.

end_line.description: Last line to read, inclusive. Requires start_line.

start_byte.description: First byte to read, inclusive. Requires end_byte.

end_byte.description: Last byte to read, inclusive. Requires start_byte.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a file with COMPLETE content. Never send patches.

function.name: rename_file
function.description: Rename or move a file or directory anywhere within the workspace. Parent directories for new_path are created automatically.

function.name: replace_in_file
function.description: Find and replace a unique string in a file.
